title: No status-token plan in singleplayer
description: The plan-the-status-phase-tokens chip and dialog exist so a person can decide while other people act. When every other seat is an in-process bot (random/smart lobby slot, as in offline singleplayer) nobody is waited on, so the chip, the dialog and the stored-plan auto-play are not offered. Tables with another human seat (or an MLP bot) keep it. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- GR.
